bagPolicy.summary: Guests attending public ticketed events at UW – Panther Arena are allowed to bring a clear stadium bag up to 12″ x 6″ x 12″, a gallon-sized clear zip bag, a wristlet up to 4″x6″x1″, or a diaper or medical bag. Bags will be searched upon entry.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions and will be searched.

parking.note: The Baird Center Garage offers convenient indoor parking with easy access to events at UW-Milwaukee Panther Arena and nearby venues. Additional parking options are available throughout downtown Milwaukee, including street spots and nearby garages.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in UW – Panther Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: UW-Milwaukee Panther Arena offers a diverse range of food and beverage options through its partner, Levy Restaurants. The menu includes quality concessions, backstage catering, and elegant banquet options, with dietary accommodations noted for gluten-free, nut, seafood, vegan, and vegetarian preferences.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by UW – Panther Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in UW – Panther Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at UW – Panther Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at UW – Panther Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
